chunks: 2479 - And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from him that he said:
"Acquire a mount, for it is an adornment, needs are fulfilled through it, and its sustenance is upon Allah, the Mighty and Glorious."

key_terms.زَيْنٌ: An adornment or means of dignity

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about keeping a riding animal?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages keeping a riding animal, describing it as a source of adornment and practical benefit. It also reminds the believer that the provision of such an animal is upon Allah, the Mighty and Glorious.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2479 - It is narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said that he heard from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as):
"Acquire a mount, for it is an adornment, needs are fulfilled through it, and its sustenance is upon Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious."
